name: Hawke’s Bay

known.via: English Wikipedia "Hawke’s Bay wine region" (redirects to "Hawke's Bay wine region")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

soil.rock: Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile. Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely.

land: The high ground runs about 9°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.
